user.title: Connect to an Allen & Heath iDR
user.description: Enter the address of the network port of the iDR. The unit must run firmware V3.50 or later, which is required for the Telnet control protocol.

data_description.host: The IP address of the iDR network port.
data_description.port: The Telnet port of the iDR. This is 23 unless you changed it.
data_description.password: Only needed when a password has been set on the iDR.
